scope: Service-page readability, generated-hardware safe lettering, calendar state, account settings, modal and notice interaction polish. No new economy or artwork.

implementation.lettering: Amounts/names are single-line; ticket inscriptions avoid seals; jade/coral buttons use ivory lettering rather than dark low-contrast text. Registered cabinet/shop controls retain their own layout.
implementation.calendar: Current day receives the existing generated jade plaque and ivory copy; other states remain on the paper surface. Day, amount and state have separate safe columns; READY clears the carved end.
implementation.account: Balance/spin/total columns and motion/sound/language buttons have separate safe bounds. Portrait selection and name instructions remain on scroll paper, not jade edges.
implementation.rank: Top-three names/scores remain clear of ribbon seals; rows 4–6 keep right-aligned scores away from wax; separate personal rank is retained.
implementation.ledger: Left-aligned activity/time and right-aligned amounts stay inside the generated ticket clear core.
implementation.modal: Full-visible-area input shield, 8 logical-pixel soft rise and .22s fade in; .14s guarded fade out. Shield persists through close; duplicate closes and stale callbacks are cancelled; reduced motion skips the tween.
implementation.notice: Existing generated wide-ticket, scaled with the page, clears navigation. Name validation is owned by the modal and uses the blank space between input and actions, not the page header.
retained: manual hall browsing and direct entry
